title: Standards & Interoperability — STEP-NC, ISO 13399, Vericut, NCSIMUL
brief: STEP-NC parser/generator (ISO 14649/AP238). ISO 13399 tool data. QIF integration. Vericut + NCSIMUL simulation bridges.

units.title: STEPNCParserEngine
units.description: Parse ISO 14649/AP238 STEP-NC. Extract workingsteps, workplans, features, tooling.

units.title: STEPNCGeneratorEngine
units.description: Generate STEP-NC from PRISM pipeline. ISO 14649 Part 10/11/12.

units.title: ISO13399ToolDataEngine
units.description: Full ISO 13399 (GTC) import/export. Tool assemblies, cutting items.

units.title: QIFIntegrationEngine
units.description: Quality Information Framework. Import measurement plans, export results.

units.title: VericutBridgeEngine
units.description: Export G-code + machine + stock + fixture for Vericut. Import OptiPath + collision results.

units.title: NCSIMULBridgeEngine
units.description: Export for NCSIMUL simulation. Import verification results.
